title: Signal
tagline: Tonight a caller says she's phoning from 2041.

facts.june_on_air: June's call went out on air.
facts.promised: You promised not to say her name.

cards.speaker: June
cards.text: The caller, June, says the town's bridge will close next spring.

a.label: Keep her on air
a.result: You leave the mic open. The board lights stay hot.
a.later: The clip went around town. Half think it's a stunt.

b.label: Cut the call
b.result: Dead air for two seconds. Then the next track.
b.later: She called the station landline at 4 a.m. and left no message.

cards.speaker: Your producer
cards.text: Your producer wants to sell the June story to a city station.

a.label: Sell it
a.result: You agree. The clip leaves town before dawn.
a.later: City vans parked outside the station for a week.

b.label: Keep it local
b.result: You shake your head. The story stays on this frequency.
b.later: The diner put a radio on the counter for your show.

cards.speaker: June
cards.text: June asks you not to tell anyone her name.

a.label: Promise
a.result: You say it into the dark booth. She hears you mean it.
a.later: She trusts you now. She calls at the same time every night.

b.label: Make no promises
b.result: You stay careful. The line cools.

cards.speaker: The mayor
cards.text: The mayor demands you stop 'spreading panic'.

a.label: Refuse on air
a.result: You say it live. The phone lines light up.
a.later: The bridge got inspected. They found the crack June described.

b.label: Agree quietly
b.result: You soften the copy. The mayor's aide sounds pleased.
b.later: The mayor sends a fruit basket. The bridge is still unchecked.

cards.speaker: June
cards.text: June says one more thing: who you'll be in 2041. Do you want to know?

a.label: Ask
a.result: You lean into the mic. She tells you.
a.later: You can't stop thinking about what she said. You've started acting like it.

b.label: Hang up first
b.result: You kill the line before the sentence arrives.
b.later: You still don't know. Some nights that's a gift.

endings.text: The bridge is fixed before spring. Nobody can prove why, but everyone tunes in now.
The calls stop. You keep the 2 a.m. slot open, just in case.
